entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text:
This is first application u/S.439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to crime No.63/2023 at Police Station Kadwaya, District Ashoknagar for the offence punishable under Sections 342, 376-D, 506-II,
323, 376(DA) of I.P.C., Section 5N/6, 5G of POCSO Act.
The allegation levelled against the applicant is that he along with co- accused persons committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated.
The entire prosecution story is doubtful because FIR is filed after almost 5 months of the date of incident.
It is further argued that no specific date, time and month has been indicated by the prosecutrix when allegedly the offence rape was committed.

As per prosecution story, the brother of Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 20 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198372876/
1 prosecutrix was present on the place at the time of incident.

entities.text: Rajesh vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: However, neither prosecutrix nor her brother informed their family members about the incident nor filed any report in police station.
It is further argued that as per report of radiologist, the age of prosecutrix is above 17 years.
In these circumstances, so also in the light of the fact that after conclusion of investigation, charge sheet has been filed; therefore, no further custodial interrogation is required.
The applicant is in custody since 17.4.2023.

Co-accused person namely, Dharmpal has already been granted bail by this Court vide order dated 23/06/2023 passed in M.CrC. No.26240/2023 and the case of present applicant on better footing than the co-accuse person.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Ashoknagar (M.P.).
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
Hence, he prays for grant of bail to applicant.
On the other hand, learned State counsel opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application i s allowed subject to DNA report.
If DNA report is found positive, the bail shall stand cancelled.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One lakh only) with a solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
